proposal: Provide prior safety scores for linked predecessor events, initially as prompt metadata.
hypothesis: Prior linked-event scores may help aggregate risk across dependent actions.
confounds: Persistence of a past violation is not a new violation by the current action
Recursive feedback may amplify false positives
Including post-action or future scores leaks information
required_controls: Graph plus real causal predecessor scores
native_interface: Inspected the preserved Kev API: SystemOneRequest accepts state and questions as JSONContent; render converts numeric values to text. The score primitive describes an output distribution, not an input channel for prior risk. No dedicated predecessor-score input exists in this inspected API. Passing numbers in structured JSON is prompt conditioning. A new learned numeric input path would require model/interface changes and validation, potentially training.
